SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TO SUPPORT THE COMMUNITY COLLEGE OF ALLEGHENY COUNTY'S MISSION OF OPEN ACCESS TO QUALITY EDUCATION AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT TRAINING.

RecipientTable.PurposeOfGrantTxt: REIMBURSEMENT FOR COLLEGE PROGRAMS FROM AVAILABLE GRANTS

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION RELIES ON THE COLLEGE TO ESTABLISH COMPENSATION OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. THE COLLEGE HIRES AN INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR TO HELP DETERMINE THE SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS FOR ALL COLLEGE EMPLOYEES (WHICH INCLUDES THE FOUNDATION EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR). THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES APPROVES THE SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS DEVELOPED BASED ON THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS INITIALLY PRESENTED TO THE FINANCE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS (BOARD) FOR A MORE DETAILED REVIEW, AND IS THEN PRESENTED TO THE FULL BOARD PRIOR TO BEING FILED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CCAC EDUCATIONAL FOUNDATION HAS ALL BOARD MEMBERS SIGN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST STATEMENT EVERY YEAR AT THE OCTOBER BOARD MEETING. COPIES OF THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST STATEMENT ARE KEPT IN THE BOARD MEMBER'S FILE WITH THE CCAC EDUCATIONAL FOUNDATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COLLEGE WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES APPROVES THE SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS OF ALL COLLEGE EMPLOYEES. THE COLLEGE HIRES AN INDEPENDENT FIRM TO STUDY AND HELP DETERMINE THE SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS FOR ALL CCAC EMPLOYEES BASED ON EDUCATIONAL LEVEL AND WORK EXPERIENCE. THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR IS AN EMPLOYEE OF THE COLLEGE AND IS A DIRECT REPORT OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE COLLEGE. SHE IS EVALUATED ON A YEARLY BASIS BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE COLLEGE AND HER SALARY IS BASED ON HER PERFORMANCE REVIEW AND COLLEGE POLICIES WITH RESPECT TO SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS FOR THOSE GRADES. ALL OTHER FOUNDATION EMPLOYEES ARE ALSO CONSIDERED TO BE EMPLOYEES OF THE COLLEGE AND ARE SUBJECT TO THE SALARY GRADES AND PAY LEVELS IN PLACE FOR COLLEGE EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, POLICIES AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF THE FOUNDATION ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
THE PROCESS FOR REVIEWING THE FINANCIALS HAS NOT CHANGED.

THE CCAC EDUCATIONAL FOUNDATION (FOUNDATION) RAISES FUNDS AND MANAGES ASSETS AND DISTRIBUTES RESOURCES TO THE COMMUNITY COLLEGE OF ALLEGHENY COUNTY (COLLEGE). AS PART OF THIS RELATIONSHIP, THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE FOUNDATION IS CONSIDERED TO BE AN EMPLOYEE OF THE COLLEGE. ALSO, THE PAYROLL FOR THE EMPLOYEES OF THE FOUNDATION ARE PROCESSED BY THE COLLEGE, AND ARE THEN REIMBURSED BY THE FOUNDATION TO THE COLLEGE, THEREFORE, ALL COMPENSATION PAID TO FOUNDATION EMPLOYEES ARE REPORTED ON THE COLLEGE'S W-3. AS A RESULT OF THIS ARRANGEMENT, THE FOUNDATION HAS REPORTED NO EMPLOYEES ON THE 12/31/12 W-3 FOR THE FORM 990 PART V, QUESTION 2A.
